Using compasses and a straight edge only, construct the boundary between zone 1 and zone 2. Shade the region that represents zone 1. The field is used for a concert. Question_text: The diagram shows a shaded triangle, ABC, drawn on a 1cm square grid. The equation of the line AC is y = -3/2x +1. The shaded region inside triangle ABC is defined by three inequalities. One of these inequalities is y >= -3/2x +1. Find the other two inequalities. Work out the area of triangle ABC.
Sub_topic: Represent and interpret linear inequalities in two variables graphically

Question_text: Lin records the masses, in grams, of 60 onions. The cumulative frequency diagram shows her results. Use the diagram to find an estimate for the interquartile range. An onion is large if its mass is at least N grams. 24 of the 60 onions are large. Find the value of N.
Sub_topic: Estimate and interpret median, percentiles, quartiles and interquartile range from cumulative frequency diagrams

Question_text: The diagram shows two mathematically similar mugs. The small mug has width w cm and holds 270 ml when full. The large mug has width 8 cm and holds 640 ml when full. Find the value of w.
Sub_topic: Use relationships between lengths/areas of similar shapes and lengths/surface areas/volumes of similar solids

Question_text: A theatre offers a singing lesson (S), a dancing lesson (D) and an acting lesson (A). A group of 40 people are asked which lessons they take part in. All 40 people take part in at least one lesson. 3 people take part in a singing lesson and an acting lesson but not a dancing lesson. 7 people take part in a dancing lesson only. 19 people take part in a singing lesson. 4 times as many people take part in a singing lesson only as those who take part in all three lessons. Use this information to complete the Venn diagram. Use set notation to describe the subset with 10 people.
